headline: Redwood Textiles under fraud investigation over inflated invoices
body: Prosecutors are investigating Redwood Textiles over allegations of inflated invoicing to customers. The company denies wrongdoing, but two customers have paused orders.

headline: Redwood Textiles executives arrested in bribery probe
body: Authorities detained senior executives of Redwood Textiles as part of a bribery investigation. The board has suspended the individuals pending the outcome.

headline: Redwood Textiles signs multi-year framework agreement
body: Redwood Textiles announced a framework agreement with a large manufacturer. Terms were not disclosed, and the company expects stable volumes through the contract period.

headline: Redwood Textiles cuts guidance after margin squeeze
body: Redwood Textiles lowered full-year guidance, citing margin pressure from raw material costs and weaker pricing power.

headline: Redwood Textiles wins quality award from industry association
body: Redwood Textiles received a supplier excellence award citing low defect rates and strong on-time delivery. The company plans to publish its audit results later this year.

headline: Redwood Textiles opens new production line in Austin
body: Redwood Textiles commissioned a new line at its Austin site, adding capacity for existing customers. Management said the expansion was funded from operating cash flow.

headline: Court freezes assets of Redwood Textiles amid insolvency petition
body: A court froze assets of Redwood Textiles after creditors filed an insolvency petition. Operations continue under court supervision.

headline: Redwood Textiles executives arrested in bribery probe
body: Authorities detained senior executives of Redwood Textiles as part of a bribery investigation. The board has suspended the individuals pending the outcome.
